title: Binance Convert Now Supports Recurring for Tokenized Securities
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.   Terms and conditions apply.   Fellow Binancians, Binance Convert is excited to introduce  Recurring  for tokenized securities – a simpler, smarter way to grow your portfolio. With  Recurring , you can automate your investments into tokenized securities via Ondo and stay consistent effortlessly. Simply set your preferred amount and schedule, then let your portfolio build over time – helping you capture opportunities in the growing world of tokenized securities.  Take the guesswork out of investing and put your strategy on autopilot. Set up your Recurring plan today and start building with confidence. How to do Recurring via Binance Convert: Step 1 : Go to the  [Trade]  tab.  Step 2:  Select the following:  App : Tap on the  [Buy/Sell]  /  [Convert]  tab. Website : Go to  [Convert & Block Trade] .  Step 3:  Select the  [Convert - Recurring] / [Recurring]  tab to access. Step 4:  Configure your preferred plan with Tokenized Securities and confirm your order. Start Recurring for Tokenized Securities Notes:   There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Tokenized securities are not issued by Binance. They are issued by third-party providers. If you need further information, please refer to the issuer’s own website.
